impact_estimate: Low for DC/operating point and basic gain; potentially moderate-to-high for stability/phase margin depending on the rest of the loop and loading.

impact_estimate: Low for core functionality; can noticeably change output swing, gain, and bias point if it was providing the dominant DC/AC load.
